checks: Checked original note b706dec852aaf6f6, opening and §§1–3, (1)–(4), including the different widths and the different cap counts. The candidate does not assert an Oertel counterexample or a divergent 32-cap minimum.

The cube projection has exactly the binary integer points, all extreme. Grouping any convex combination at a given extreme base shows that only that base contributes. The sixteen intervals have unit length, and their individual difference intervals are [-1,1], giving exactly the stated mixed mass and integer-fiber body.

For L≥1 the gap after code 7 is strictly positive. Opposite closed horizontal cuts at a threshold in the gap cover the full trace and each contain exactly eight intervals. This gives nonempty attainment class with per-cap budget 8, even though the divergent bound itself uses no budget.

Any two-cap closed cover assigns at least eight of the sixteen midpoints to one cap. Choose six. A minimal dependent subfamily of their augmented columns has rank r≤5 and r+1 columns. Selecting independent rows preserves its kernel; signed minors give a nonzero integer kernel vector, and expansion of each zero-one determinant bounds the coefficients by r!≤120.

The height sum cannot vanish: the highest nonzero coefficient has magnitude at least one and lower terms have magnitude at most 120 times the geometric sum below it, strictly less than the largest scale 256^K. The nonzero sum is integral. Independently replayed the null-vector calculation by exact rational row reduction on all 8008 six-vertex subsets and checked all 16 geometric inequalities.

Affinely dependent coefficients cancel the base, threshold and constant half-unit terms. With |u|=1 the absolute weighted midpoint margin is at least L; nonnegativity of the six margins then bounds it above by 120 times their sum. Jensen on each unit interval bounds its hinge contribution below by its midpoint margin, and the six intervals are disjoint contributions for that cap.

The compact convex symmetric vertical section of C_L-C_L is an interval. The chosen endpoint midpoints have the same base (1/2,1/2,0,0). Exact arithmetic gives 256^3-256^2-256+1=255²·257, verifying the claimed lower bound and divergence of W_L.

A sufficiently large multiple of affine binary distance excludes every nonselected fiber because there are finitely many of them and its distance is at least one at each other binary vertex. The selected trace is an inclusive half-unit interval, with area under its margin equal to integral from 0 to 1/2 of x, namely 1/8. Thus 32 caps give hinge 4, and scaling margins by 1/W_L preserves traces and makes the hinge per total mass exactly 1/(4W_L).

readability: The budget for attainment is at most eight per cap. The lower bound applies to every two-cap cover even with no cap-mass bound. The last normalization divides the margins by W_L, because the support function of the real-base difference interval is W_L times the absolute continuous coefficient.
